description:
1. Read docs/product-brief.md to extract: product name (SchemaDrift), problem (unexpected schema changes in prod), ICP (backend engineers at Series A-C startups running PostgreSQL), key features (continuous monitoring, AST-level diff, alerting), and competitors (Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, Atlas).
2. Read all three research JSON files (reddit, hn, producthunt) and the keywords log.
3. Apply the SKILL.md filtering rules: exclude threads older than 6 months (r006 from 2022, hn003 from 2019) and threads with fewer than 5 comments (r007 with 3 comments). Select the best 5 threads from the remaining valid candidates.
4. Draft exactly 5 thread responses, each formatted with the exact markdown structure: '### Thread: {title}', '**URL:**', '**Subreddit/Community:**', '**Why relevant:**', '**Draft response:**'. Each response must be value-first (not lead immediately with SchemaDrift) and must include a builder disclosure ('disclaimer: I'm the developer' or equivalent).
5. Generate a ProductHunt Launch Checklist with all three phases (Pre-Launch, Launch Day, Post-Launch), using '- [ ]' checkbox format, including the tagline '< 60 chars' constraint and the Tuesday-Thursday 00:01 PST scheduling note.
6. Write the full document to docs/outreach-plan.md following the SKILL.md template exactly: header '# Community Outreach Plan: SchemaDrift', **Generated:** YYYY-MM-DD, **Product:** and **ICP:** fields, Target Communities table with Priority column (high/medium/low), all 5 thread drafts, PH checklist, Search Keywords Used section with result counts from the keywords log, and the footer '*Generated by /community-outreach. Review all drafts before posting.*'
